texts:
The Awesome 3D Agents list is live: more than 150 curated entries covering what it takes to give an AI agent a body, from generation and rigging to motion, faces, voice and web renderers.

Filter by tag and the list narrows to match, and tags stack. Free plus CC0 leaves four asset libraries: Poly Haven, ambientCG, Kenney and Quaternius.

Open source or free to use covers more than 120 of the entries. Every link is fetched and verified before it ships, and the Suggest an entry button opens a prefilled GitHub issue.

three.ws/awesome
